name: com.streethawk.library.SHFeedbackActivity
description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. StreetHawk opens this Activity from a campaign feedback prompt. It lets the user enter a subject and comment, sends the feedback to StreetHawk, and reports whether the prompt was accepted or dismissed.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to open StreetHawk's built-in feedback form from campaign prompts.
